# Painter

Painter is a professional painting company based in Paintville, CA, serving 25+ cities. Services: interior painting, exterior painting, commercial painting, and color consultation. 10+ years of experience, 500+ projects, 98% happy customers, 5-year workmanship warranty. Fixed, transparent quotes — no hidden costs.
